name: fluidvoice.best-asr
notes: Maintainer-recommended local ASR for accuracy: the highest accuracy rating in FluidVoice's model list (accuracyPercent 0.98, shared with Fluid Speech Pro), language set to English as the app asks. Alternative English-only pick: Parakeet TDT v2 (0.96, 'Higher Accuracy'). Cleanup off.
verify: FluidVoice downloads Cohere Transcribe itself: choose it in Settings > Voice Engine (English), then add its model folder to model.files.
